From: Elena Morales <emorales@greenleaf.health>

Date: 2027-09-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Starting the MAP — hosting preference + timeline ask

Vivek / Redwood team,

Thanks for the call this morning. We had a short executive sync and want to capture a clear mutual action plan (MAP) so we can decide between Hosted, Dedicated, or Private (on‑VPC) for our inference layer. High‑level asks from Greenleaf:

- We need a recommended deployment route given our PHI workload and anticipated 30M monthly inference tokens.
- An evaluation plan (PoV) that includes quality gates, performance targets (p50/p95 latency), and cost targets per 1M tokens.
- A close timeline: procurement + security review + contract execution target is 2027‑10‑28 (we’d like Redwood’s help to hit that).

Can you send a MAP draft with milestones, owners, and any blocking items (legal/security) we should prioritize? If you have a short table with pros/cons for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private relative to our needs, that would be very helpful.

Elena
Elena Morales
VP Digital Platforms, Greenleaf Health
em: emorales@greenleaf.health
Office: +1 415 555 0192

Note: Procurement copied separately (procure@greenleaf.health)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <emorales@greenleaf.health>, procure@greenleaf.health
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-20T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starting the MAP — hosting preference + timeline ask

Elena — thanks, and appreciate the clarity on the timeline. Attached is a first draft MAP and short decision memo. Key callouts up front:

1) Recommendation (short): run a Dedicated pool in US‑EAST (single region) during PoV with an option to convert to Private (VPC) prior to full production cutover. This balances predictable throughput for 30M tokens, PHI isolation, and speed to close.

2) Quick pros/cons (summary):
- Hosted: fastest onboarding; lower operational lift; out of the box monitoring; less control over KMS/HSM for PHI. Good if you can accept contract + DPA with standard SOC2 boundary.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU capacity under your tenant; predictable latency and cost; can meet tighter SLAs; supports bring‑your‑own‑KMS integrations in many cases.
- Private (VPC/on‑prem): highest isolation and compliance control; longer setup and network onboarding; recommended if you must have private networking or air‑gapped controls.

3) MAP milestones (high level, full spreadsheet attached):
- 2027‑09‑22: MAP draft review (Redwood + Greenleaf) — owners: Vivek (Redwood) / Elena (Greenleaf)
- 2027‑09‑27: PoV test plan approved (scenarios, metrics, dataset slices) — owners: Karthik (Redwood SE) / Greenleaf Eng lead
- 2027‑10‑11: Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence exchange complete — owners: Laura (Redwood SOC2 lead) / Greenleaf Security
- 2027‑10‑18: Contract redline complete / signature ready — owners: Redwood Legal / Greenleaf Procurement
- 2027‑10‑28: Target go/no‑go for production path & procurement signoff

4) PoV scope (short): 
- 2 week PoV window in Dedicated US‑EAST: run standard inference loads (chat + structured prompt patterns), measure p50/p95 latencies; validate prefix KV cache for top 15 request templates; evaluate quantization profile for cost reduction.
- Quality gate: automated evals against grade set (accuracy/regression tolerance <= 2% from baseline).

5) Blocking items we see now: 
- KMS/HSM requirement for PHI: if Greenleaf requires customer‑managed keys, we will need to coordinate with Redwood Private or Dedicated with BYOK.
- Network egress/geofencing: confirm whether data must remain in US only (you noted yes).
- Procurement cadence: if legal has >3 redline asks, SOW timeline could slip.

Attachments included: MAP_Greenleaf_v2.xlsx (detailed milestones + owners), PoV-runbook-templates.docx, SOC2_scope_snapshot.pdf

Next step: Can we review the MAP on 2027‑09‑22 at 9:00AM PT? I’ll have Karthik walk through the PoV test plan and Laura cover the security evidence items.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-09-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal — readiness notes for Greenleaf PoV (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Vivek / Laura — quick internal note (we should not include this in client thread if we separate internal discussion):

- PoV config: I recommend we provision a Dedicated pool sized for sustained 3x expected concurrency to avoid cold‑start noise on metrics. For Greenleaf’s 30M tokens/month estimate, that maps to approximately 2x RTX A40 equivalent nodes for baseline PoV (we’ll refine after sample telemetry).
- KMS: Greenleaf indicated strict PHI rules. Laura, do we have a standard BYOK flow for Dedicated that ties into customer KMS (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS)? If not, we need to flag the Private path as a contingency.
- Data residency: they said US only — set routing to US‑EAST, add guardrails to prevent accidental EU routing during PoV.
- Legal: expect two main redlines — indemnity limits and DPA clauses around data retention. Vivek, I’ll draft the short memo for legal to speed review.

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize PoV-runbook and perf targets by EOD 2027‑09‑22.
- Laura: compile SOC2 artifacts and BYOK capabilities note by 2027‑09‑25.
- Vivek: confirm 9/22 9AM PT call with Greenleaf and attach the draft memo for Legal.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Vivek / team — thanks for the plan and the attachments. We reviewed the MAP with our Security and Procurement teams this morning. Two decisions coming out of that review: 

1) We’ll proceed with a Dedicated US‑EAST PoV with BYOK enabled (Greenleaf will bring KMS keys). This gives us the isolation and predictable latency we need while keeping the option to convert to Private if legal requires more controls.

2) Procurement target remains 2027‑10‑28. To support that, please: 
- Share the draft SOW and DPA by 2027‑09‑27 (so Legal can start redlines).
- Confirm network onboarding checklist (firewall rules, IP ranges) by 2027‑09‑29.
- Provide a 2‑week PoV runbook (start window 2027‑10‑03) with explicit perf acceptance criteria and eval scripts.

We’ll book the 9/22 call as a prep with our Eng + Security (moved to 9/24 at 11:00AM PT). If Redwood can hit the SOW + DPA deliverable on 9/27, Procurement will run parallel reviews to keep to the 10/28 target.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Morales
VP Digital Platforms, Greenleaf Health
